posts.title: Know the whole price. Then say yes.
posts.x:
The product price isn't the whole price.

BUY HARD checks checkout terms before offering purchase approval. Still checking? No approval yet.

posts.linkedinTagged:
The box of cups looks affordable. Then shipping and tax show up.

Your buyer should bring you the decision with those details checked.

BUY HARD's latest checkout update keeps unverified purchases at ‘Checking checkout total and delivery’. It doesn't offer purchase approval until the terms have been checked.

The update is deployed; the checkout tests used controlled stores. A first real merchant purchase is still a separate pilot. This card illustrates the workflow.

Bring one recurring item to a walkthrough and we'll look at the buying details that matter to you:
https://buyhard.app/walkthrough?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=buyhard_allgas_202609&utm_content=whole_checkout_price

Built with @[Convex](urn:li:organization:71328718), @[OpenAI](urn:li:organization:11130470), @[Firecrawl](urn:li:organization:104100957), and @[AgentMail (YC S25)](urn:li:organization:106989461) for the Convex All Gas Hackathon.
